model: CON with input autoencoding (node-con-iae), official beta-VAE
dataset: Identical 343 assemblies and 813/54/54/108 sequences as frozen KeyCLD corpus; no new video generation.

training.checkpoint: Final epoch 50; no test-based selection; full optimizer, PRNG, data-order resume.
training.last_batch: Include every sequence; last batch uses its actual size.
training.solver: Official Dopri5 with constant 0.01 s steps; complete 50-frame rollouts.
training.velocity: Video: official encoder JVP of centered three-frame image difference; state: exact prefix velocity.
training.state_control: Physical B/C/midpoint coordinates padded to dimension 8; only the official CON dynamics train. Privileged diagnostic, not video performance.

inputs.semantics: Command-and-geometry-conditioned closed-loop system; input reconstruction is in declared normalized command units, not latent force calibration.
inputs.inference: Only three real images are encoded; forecast from the middle observed frame; future time grid extends through original frame 119.
inputs.camera: Same calibrated 64x64 images and known recorded-camera limitations as KeyCLD.

evaluation.primary_video: Future RGB MSE and persistence, separately from latent-state diagnostics.
evaluation.video_physical_readout: One affine latent-to-point map fitted only on training labels after freezing; validation semantic error and raw geometry coverage reported. This is a privileged downstream readout diagnostic, not the public video-reader track; never feeds model predictions.
evaluation.derivatives: Native ODE derivatives at 240 Hz; same SI independent equations and thresholds as KeyCLD corpus.
evaluation.coverage: Raw geometry; no IK or projection. Unavailable SI values remain null with all test cases in denominator.
evaluation.aggregation: Family then condition equal weight; seeds and assembly clusters bootstrap, 2000 draws.
evaluation.calibration: Reuse hash-bound independently validated 54 calibration references; no model tuning on calibration or test.
evaluation.comparison: Matched data, cameras and commands; model-native training budgets and losses differ. Do not present as equal-update comparison.
